dsh-change-review is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-370295f1c19dd20b580b.html
